title: FYI Yachts Featured on Good Morning America Showcasing Miami's Luxury Yachting Lifestyle
description: FYI Yachts featured on Good Morning America, showcasing Miami’s luxury yachting lifestyle with Sam Champion. Discover boating paradise year-round.
html:
FYI Yachts Shines on Good Morning America: A Miami Boating Showcase with Sam Champion

Miami, FL – FYI Yachts was proud to be featured on ABC’s Good Morning America in a special segment hosted by Sam Champion, showcasing “The Ultimate Insider’s Guide to Miami.” Together, we set out on a scenic cruise through the iconic Miami skyline, past the exclusive estates of Star Island, and along the vibrant coast of Miami Beach.

The episode spotlighted Miami’s unique charm as a boating paradise where luxury yachting is not just seasonal, but a lifestyle 365 days a year.

Watch the full segment here: GMA Insider’s Guide to Miami

In Miami, Every Season is Boating Season

At FYI Yachts, we’ve been immersed in the heart of Miami’s yachting culture for over 35 years, proudly representing this city and its incredible marine lifestyle. With our year-round sunshine, world-famous coastlines, and thriving maritime community, Miami stands as one of the top yachting destinations in the world, and it’s our greatest passion to serve it.

Whether you’re cruising Biscayne Bay or heading out to the Bahamas, the journey starts here.

On Board the 105’ Azimut: “Sale Vita”

Filmed aboard the luxurious Azimut 105 “Sale Vita”, the experience gave viewers an up-close look at the elegance, comfort, and performance that define FYI Yachts. “Sale Vita” offered the perfect platform for an unforgettable cruise, with spacious decks, panoramic views, and refined Italian design setting the tone for a truly Miami-style welcome.

Our Clients Are the Heart of Our Mission

This unforgettable day on the water with Good Morning America is more than just a media moment, it’s a celebration of the community we serve. Our clients are the reason we’ve thrived for over three decades. Your trust, loyalty, and shared love for the water are the driving forces behind everything we do.

At FYI Yachts, we’re not just selling boats, we’re building relationships that last generations.

Thank You, Sam Champion & GMA

We extend our deepest gratitude to Sam Champion and the entire Good Morning America team for highlighting FYI Yachts and the magic of boating in Miami. Your visit was a true honor and a reminder of why we love what we do.

We look forward to having you on board again soon, Sam!
